blocks.en: Let $s>1/2$. Then there exists a bounded linear mapping $Z:H^{s-1/2}(\mathbb{R}^{m-1})\to H^s(\mathbb{R}^m)$ such that $TZ$ is the identity.
blocks.zh: 设 $s>1/2$. 那么存在有界线性映射 $Z:H^{s-1/2}(\mathbb{R}^{m-1})\to H^s(\mathbb{R}^m)$, 使 $TZ$ 为恒等映射.
